headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve ClearInstall’s risk assessment capabilities, making it more accurate and efficient. Leverage AI for better binding.gyp command expansion detection and overall install-surface auditing.
actions: Implement machine learning models to analyze npm/PyPI package dependencies and identify potential risks before installation.
Develop an AI-driven module to automatically detect and warn about binding.gyp command expansions, enhancing security checks.
Utilize natural language processing (NLP) techniques to enhance the readability of risk assessments, making them more accessible to users.
